title: Gogs
descript: Gogs is a lightweight self-hosted Git service: create repositories, browse code and history, manage issues, pull requests and wikis, and clone over HTTP - all from one small container with an SQLite database in the application data folder. It is a good fit for a personal or small-team Git server on the NAS.
release_note: 1. First release: Gogs 0.13.3 from Docker Hub as a non-root container. Lightweight Git server with issues, pull requests and wikis; SQLite data in the application data folder.
important: Requires DockerEngine (installed automatically if missing). The first visit opens the install wizard (/install) - set the admin account and keep SQLite as the database, application URL http://<NAS-IP>:<port>/. Repositories and the database live in DockerAppData/gogsdocker/data. SSH access (port 22) is NOT published by this package; clone over HTTP or use a reverse proxy. Plain HTTP.

wrapper_note:
the image runs its own s6 supervisor as root and switches to the git user,
which is impossible inside a non-root container. This wrapper starts the gogs
binary directly with GOGS_WORK_DIR on the mounted data volume.
wrapper_note_readme: - **Entrypoint wrapper**: bypasses the upstream s6 supervisor and runs `gogs web` with `GOGS_WORK_DIR=/data` as uid 1000.

zh-cn.descript: Gogs 是轻量级自建 Git 服务：创建仓库、浏览代码与历史、管理 issue、合并请求和 wiki，支持 HTTP 克隆——一个小容器加一个 SQLite 数据库就够，数据保存在应用数据目录，适合在 NAS 上做个人或小团队 Git 服务器。
zh-cn.important: 需要 DockerEngine（缺失时应用中心会自动安装）。首次访问会进入安装向导（/install）：设置管理员账号、数据库保持 SQLite、应用地址填 http://<NAS-IP>:<端口>/。仓库与数据库保存在 DockerAppData/gogsdocker/data。本包**没有**发布 SSH（22）端口，请用 HTTP 克隆或走反向代理。界面为纯 HTTP。
zh-cn.release_note: 1. 首个版本：基于 Docker Hub 的 Gogs 0.13.3，以非 root 容器运行。轻量 Git 服务，支持 issue、合并请求与 wiki；SQLite 数据保存在应用数据目录。

zh-hk.descript: Gogs 是輕量級自建 Git 服務：建立倉庫、瀏覽程式碼與歷史、管理 issue、合併請求與 wiki，支援 HTTP 克隆——一個小容器加一個 SQLite 資料庫就夠，資料保存在應用資料目錄，適合在 NAS 上做個人或小團隊 Git 伺服器。
zh-hk.important: 需要 DockerEngine（缺少時應用中心會自動安裝）。首次存取會進入安裝精靈（/install）：設定管理員帳號、資料庫保持 SQLite、應用位址填 http://<NAS-IP>:<端口>/。倉庫與資料庫保存在 DockerAppData/gogsdocker/data。本包**沒有**發佈 SSH（22）端口，請用 HTTP 克隆或走反向代理。介面為純 HTTP。
zh-hk.release_note: 1. 首個版本：基於 Docker Hub 的 Gogs 0.13.3，以非 root 容器運行。輕量 Git 服務，支援 issue、合併請求與 wiki；SQLite 資料保存在應用資料目錄。

data_notes: `/data` (mounted from `DockerAppData/gogsdocker/data`) holds `gogs/conf/app.ini`, the SQLite database, repositories, avatars and logs.
design_notes: **Direct binary start.** s6 cannot run as uid 1000; the wrapper runs `gogs web` with the work directory on the volume.
**SQLite only.** No database server; repositories are plain folders under the data directory.
limitations: - SSH cloning is not published; use HTTP(S) or a reverse proxy.
- First-run settings are stored in `app.ini`; changing them needs a restart.
- The UI is plain HTTP; use a TLS reverse proxy before exposing it to the internet.
